name: tkb
description: Phần mềm xếp thời khóa biểu offline
author: tkb

scripts.test:solver: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const { existsSync } = require('fs'); const p = process.platform === 'win32' && existsSync('solver/.venv/Scripts/python.exe') ? 'solver/.venv/Scripts/python.exe' : 'solver/.venv/bin/python3'; const r = spawnSync(p, ['solver/test_solver_comprehensive.py'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(r.status ?? 0);"
scripts.test:backend: npx esbuild src/main/test_integration_all.ts --bundle --platform=node --external:better-sqlite3 --outfile=out/test_integration.js && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 npx electron out/test_integration.js
scripts.test: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:solver && pnpm run test:backend
